ui.title: 程序员延寿指南
ui.intro: 多一些精力做喜欢的事，多一些时间陪重要的人。从饮食、运动、睡眠开始，了解哪些习惯有助于健康，一起健康快乐地活得更久。
ui.caution: ACM 指全因死亡率，关注研究期间因各种原因发生的死亡。阅读时，先看研究比较了哪些人，再看效应量和区间；点开感兴趣的条目，可以了解研究人群、具体结果与原文出处。
ui.sideNote: 先看研究对象和比较条件，再看数字。字母等级衡量本条 ACM 证据，不代表推荐强度。
ui.methodIntro: 每条记录列出研究对象、比较条件、结果与来源。先看看研究和自己的情况是否接近，再了解它发现了什么。
ui.methodAssociation: 效应量描述两组之间的差异，区间反映估计的不确定程度；阅读时结合比较组、基线风险和随访时间。
ui.methodNegative: 全因死亡、疾病发生和生物标志物回答的是不同问题，先确认研究衡量的是什么。
ui.methodRead: 来源标注已阅读的内容：元数据、摘要或关键正文。可以沿链接继续读原始研究。
ui.methodScope: 饮食、运动、睡眠等主题持续补充，欢迎提供新研究或纠正遗漏。
ui.cochrane: 阅读参考：Cochrane Handbook，第 14 章 ↗

ui.title: A Programmer’s Guide to Longevity
ui.intro: More energy for what you love. More time with the people who matter. Explore research on food, movement and sleep, and find habits for a longer, healthier, happier life.
ui.caution: ACM means all-cause mortality: deaths from any cause during a study. Start with who was compared, then read the effect estimate and its interval. Open a topic to see the study population, findings and original sources.
ui.sideNote: Read the population and comparison before the number. Letter grades describe the ACM evidence, not the strength of a recommendation.
ui.methodIntro: Each record shows who was studied, what was compared, what was found and where to read more. Start by considering how closely the study matches your own situation.
ui.methodAssociation: Effect estimates describe differences between groups; intervals express uncertainty. Read them alongside the comparison group, baseline risk and follow-up.
ui.methodNegative: All-cause mortality, disease occurrence and biomarkers answer different questions. First check what the study measured.
ui.methodRead: Sources show what was read: metadata, abstract or key full-text sections. Follow the link to continue with the original research.
ui.methodScope: Topics such as food, movement and sleep continue to grow. New studies and corrections are welcome.
ui.footerNote: Read offline · Built together, in the open
